answer_1.quote: We propose a human-intuitive approach for aligning sensor data with descriptive text, eliminating the need for manual annotations. SensorLLM generates trend descriptions from sensor data...
answer_1.outputs: Descriptive natural‑language text summarising sensor trend patterns (e.g., upward, downward, stable segments) for each channel

answer_2.quote: We adopt three evaluation methods: • NLP Metrics. We use BLEU-1, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-L, and METEOR ... For deeper semantic alignment and factual correctness, we adopt SBERT and SimCSE.

answer_3.quote: GPT-4o rates the generated trend descriptions on a scale of 1 to 5 (with 5 being the highest) by comparing each output to ground truth and providing explanatory feedback.

answer_4.quote: Five time-series experts (PhD students, postdocs, and academics) score accuracy and quality using the same criteria as GPT-4o.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated description for accuracy and quality using the same criteria as GPT-4o (correctness, completeness, coherence).
